Tolerance Decisions for Between-Person Variances and Covariances

Source: R/manMetaVAR-tolerance.R
Tolerance.Rd

Classifies estimates and interval limits of between-person variances and covariances against a tolerance \(\delta\) instead of exact zero. Variances are compared one-sided with \(\delta\); covariances two-sided with \([-\delta, \delta]\).

Usage

Tolerance(est, ll, ul, variance, delta)

Arguments

est

Numeric vector. Estimates.

ll

Numeric vector. Lower interval limits.

ul

Numeric vector. Upper interval limits.

variance

Logical vector. TRUE for variances, FALSE for covariances.

delta

Nonnegative numeric value. Tolerance.

Value

A data frame with logical columns est_within (estimate within the tolerance), equivalent (interval within the tolerance: practical homogeneity), and exceed (interval beyond the tolerance: heterogeneity beyond the tolerance).

Author

Ivan Jacob Agaloos Pesigan

Examples

Tolerance(
  est = c(0.0002, 0.01),
  ll = c(0, 0.004),
  ul = c(0.0008, 0.02),
  variance = c(TRUE, TRUE),
  delta = 0.0009
)
#>   est_within equivalent exceed
#> 1       TRUE       TRUE  FALSE
#> 2      FALSE      FALSE   TRUE
